recipes.title: Lemon Butter Pasta
recipes.description: Silky, bright and on the table before the kettle cools.
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Melt the butter in a wide pan over low heat, add the garlic and cook gently for 1 minute — don't let it colour.
Zest the lemon into the butter, then squeeze in the juice and swirl to make a glossy sauce.
Lift the pasta straight into the pan with a splash of its cooking water and toss hard until every strand is coated.
Fold through the parmesan and parsley, season generously, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: One-Pan Chicken & Peas
recipes.description: Crisp skin, soft peas, one tray to wash. The weeknight classic.
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, bone in and skin on
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Pat the chicken dry, season it well and rub with a little oil.
Sit the thighs skin-side up in a roasting tray and roast for 20 minutes until the skin starts to crisp.
Scatter the onion and garlic around the chicken, pour in the stock and return to the oven for 10 minutes.
Tip in the peas and lemon wedges for the last 5 minutes, until the peas are just tender.
Spoon the pan juices over everything and serve with crusty bread or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Coconut Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: A pantry curry that tastes like you planned it all week.
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet, then leave it covered off the heat.
Warm the coconut oil in a deep pan and soften the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and chickpeas, season, and simmer for 12 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until it wilts, squeeze in the lime, and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Salmon & Greens
recipes.description: Fifteen minutes of oven time, zero fuss, dinner sorted.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender.
Spread the potatoes and green beans on a tray, drizzle with oil and season.
Sit the salmon among the vegetables, top with lemon slices, and roast for 12–14 minutes.
Scatter with dill and serve straight from the tray with the lemony pan juices.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Tall, soft stacks for slow mornings and hungry children.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt in a big bowl.
Beat the buttermilk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla in a jug.
Pour the wet into the dry and fold just until combined — lumps are your friend.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while a non-stick pan warms over medium heat.
Cook ladlefuls for 2 minutes until bubbles pop, flip, and give them another minute.

recipes.title: Tomato & White Bean Stew
recipes.description: Cheap, cosy and better the next day. Freeze half for future you.
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes with a pinch of salt.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and paprika and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock. Simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Crush a few beans against the pan to thicken the stew, then taste and season.
Finish with parsley and a drizzle of olive oil, with toast on the side.

recipes.title: Garlic Mushroom Toast
recipes.description: Buttery mushrooms piled on sourdough. Lunch, sorted in 15.
steps: Toast the sourdough until deeply golden and rub lightly with a cut garlic clove.
Melt half the butter in a wide pan and fry the mushrooms in a single layer, undisturbed, for 3 minutes.
Stir, add the rest of the butter and the garlic, and cook for 2 more minutes.
Finish with lemon zest, parsley and plenty of pepper, then pile onto the toast.

recipes.title: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Glossy, savoury and faster than a takeaway order.
steps: Cook the rice and keep it covered.
Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch and leave it for 10 minutes.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Sear the beef in a very hot wok for 90 seconds, remove, then fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef with the broccoli, remaining soy and honey, and toss until glossy. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato Bowls
recipes.description: Golden cubes, crisp chickpeas and a lemony yogurt swoosh.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with oil, cumin and salt.
Roast on a large tray for 25 minutes, shaking halfway, until the edges are crisp.
Stir the lemon juice into the yogurt with a pinch of salt.
Wilt the spinach in a hot pan for 1 minute.
Build the bowls with spinach, roast vegetables, feta and a generous spoon of lemon yogurt.

recipes.title: Apple & Oat Crumble
recipes.description: The smell of a Sunday kitchen. Serve with cold cream.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Toss the apples with sugar and cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the flour and cold butter together with your fingertips until it looks like rough breadcrumbs.
Stir in the oats, brown sugar and salt.
Scatter the crumble over the apples in a thick, uneven layer.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until bubbling at the edges and golden on top. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sunday Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a smoky tomato pan. Bring bread, bring people.
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes until slippery and sweet.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover the pan and cook for 5–7 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with feta and cilantro and bring the pan to the table.

recipes.title: Cucumber & Feta Salad
recipes.description: Crunchy, salty, lemony. The ten-minute side that steals the show.
steps: Salt the cucumber slices lightly in a colander for 5 minutes, then pat dry.
Whisk the lemon juice with the olive oil and a good grind of pepper.
Toss the cucumber with the dressing, dill and mint.
Scatter over the feta and serve straight away while it's crisp.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Blueberries
recipes.description: Five minutes tonight, breakfast already sorted tomorrow.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, honey and vanilla together in a bowl or two jars.
Cover and chill overnight — at least 6 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk and top with blueberries and seeds.

recipes.title: Tomato & Cheddar Toastie
recipes.description: Buttered sourdough, sharp cheddar, sweet tomato. Lunch in ten.
steps: Butter the outside of each slice of bread and spread mustard on the insides.
Layer cheddar and tomato, season, and close the sandwiches.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until deeply golden.
Cut in half and eat while the cheese is stretchy.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Tuna Salad
recipes.description: A ten-minute lunch with crunch, lemon and plenty of protein.
steps: Flake the tuna into a big bowl and add the chickpeas.
Fold in the cucumber, tomatoes and parsley.
Dress with olive oil and lemon, season generously, and toss gently. Serve with leaves or warm flatbread.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Sweet roasted tomatoes blitzed into a velvety bowl.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil, salt and paprika on a tray.
Roast for 25 minutes until the edges are sticky and caramelised.
Tip everything into a pot with the stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Blend until smooth — add a splash more stock if you like it thinner.
Season to taste and finish with torn basil and a swirl of oil.
